📉 What moved today, Friday 20 November

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 fell 1.6% to 96,833, its sixth losing day in a row. Resource shares dropped 2.3% as gold slid again, to about $3,555.

🗓️ This week: the Top 40 is down about 7.3%, and the rand is about 2.8% weaker than last Friday (about R16.95).

💱 Today the rand firmed slightly to about R17.43 to the dollar. Brent oil fell 1.4% to about $90.69.

What it means for you: cheaper oil helps the December petrol picture, but a weaker rand this week works against it.

Prices are 15-minute delayed. Education, not financial advice.
